reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: APPOINTMENT OF CHAIRMAN TO THE BOARD
reqBaseAnnouncement.profile:
Mr. Abishek Sithampalam is a Sri Lankan entrepreneur and technology visionary with extensive experience in establishing, developing and scaling businesses, driving digital transformation and identifying strategic growth opportunities across diverse industry sectors.
He is the Co-Founder of findmyfare.com, one of Sri Lanka’s pioneering online travel agencies, which he has successfully grown into a multi-billion-rupee enterprise. Through this venture, he has demonstrated a strong ability to harness technology, build scalable digital platforms and transform traditional business models through innovation, operational excellence and customer-centric solutions.
 
He currently serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Knightsbridge Technologies, a software solutions company specializing in banking technology, where he provides leadership in driving technology-led business development and growth. He also serves as Chairman of Anantaya Resorts & Spa, a hospitality group with interests in the ownership and operation of two large-scale five-star hotels in Sri Lanka. These roles reflect his breadth of commercial experience and his involvement in developing and leading businesses across both technology-driven and asset-intensive industries.
Through his entrepreneurial ventures and leadership positions spanning digital commerce, financial technology and hospitality, Mr. Sithampalam brings to the Board a distinctive combination of strategic vision, entrepreneurial drive, commercial acumen and business leadership experience. His proven ability to identify opportunities, leverage technology, build scalable enterprises and drive business growth is expected to contribute valuable perspectives to the Board’s deliberations and support the Group’s strategic direction, future growth ambitions and the creation of sustainable long-term shareholder value.
